effect.hatmod.veil.description: Plain vanilla Invisibility (the status bar shows this Divine Veil entry only, never a separate Invisibility one): the model vanishes exactly as vanilla does, while armour and held items stay visible. Kept up while flashing, then lasts another 6/8/10s (by Radiance level); while veiled it periodically shakes off mobs that had already locked onto you.
enchantment.hatmod.afterimage.desc: One extra blink-dodge during the beam phase per level (3 total at III); the dodged hit misses completely.
enchantment.hatmod.benediction.desc: The permanent Speed and Jump Boost are one level higher per level (Jump Boost caps at II).
enchantment.hatmod.bloodthirst.desc: Damage dealt by the beam heals you for 5% per level, uncapped; healing that overflows at full health becomes green hearts with no loss - a separate shield that outranks golden hearts: incoming damage drains green hearts first, and only then golden hearts and health. Green hearts last forever but decay faster the more you have (1s per heart at the base, exponentially quicker as the pool grows). Vanilla golden hearts are untouched.
enchantment.hatmod.conflagration.desc: Every hat naturally fires 2 beams at once; each beam deals half the old single-beam damage, so the pair matches the old total, and the two stack on the same target with no falloff. This enchantment adds one more per level (3/4/5 total at I/II/III): with enough enemies each takes a different one; with too few (a lone boss) the extra beams stack on the nearest enemies with diminishing returns (the 2nd/3rd extra beam on the same target = 40%/16%), while the base two never lose damage.
enchantment.hatmod.dominion.desc: +5s per level: at charge second 15, the 5 nearest enemies lose their target (+5 per level, up to 15) and are outlined. A dominated mob that still has other enemies nearby is turned on them instead. Works on Wardens too: their target lives in brain memory, so it is wiped together with their anger.
enchantment.hatmod.formless.desc: One extra blink-dodge during the charge phase per level (6 total at III).
enchantment.hatmod.radiance.desc: While firing, you and every ally inside the time-dilation field gain Divine Veil (widen the field with Slow Field and the veil covers more of them) - plain vanilla Invisibility, the model vanishing exactly as vanilla does, plus it periodically shakes off mobs that had already locked onto you, Wardens included. Divine Veil lasts 6/8/10s (by this enchantment's level) and is topped back up when under 2s remain, so it keeps going that long after the beam ends. No longer adds beam damage.
enchantment.hatmod.requiem.desc: The time-dilation field's radius grows by 1 block per level.
enchantment.hatmod.soul_reap.desc: The moment your charge completes, pin every enemy within 30 blocks - exactly the same effect as the charging time-dilation field. The duration scales with this enchantment's level: 1/3, 2/3 or 3/3 of what is left of the cycle (level III lasts the whole cycle). From the moment it starts, your view stays black-and-white for the whole duration, and "I saw this coming." appears.
hatmod.forcebreak.warning:
Force-break enabled: this is a cheat-level mode. It takes over enemy health, bypasses death logic and may forcibly remove entities.
Animations, drops, boss bars and saves can break. Use at your own risk.
hatmod.khragg.desc: The developer's avatar (an easter egg): right-click the ground to spawn - the whole server hears him join. Never spawns naturally.
hatmod.khragg.usage1: · Hit him once: the fight starts - charge beams, sword pressure, gap-closing slams.
hatmod.khragg.usage2: · First kill: he revives at full health wearing Brainrot (phase two). The second kill is final.
hatmod.khragg.usage3: · Outrun him: he blinks next to you. Get too far: he walks home. Bring enough DPS for two rounds.
hatmod.khragg.provoke: So you want to fight me?
hatmod.khragg.win: How are you even worse than me.
hatmod.qte.reward.acc.ready: Auto hats · 1 dodge ready (recharges after use)
hatmod.qte.reward.title: Beat rewards
hatmod.teto.achv.rhythm.1: I've seen all-PERFECT runs. All-PERFECT while never once leaving the fight - that I haven't. Rhythm Master, and it's yours.
hatmod.teto.achv.rhythm.2: Every beat clean... and you never once stepped off the battlefield. That title isn't mine to give - you fought it out yourself.
hatmod.teto.adopt.1: You put this on? ...Then I'm dancing!
hatmod.teto.adopt.t3.1: Coming, coming- don't rush me. The song's already started, of course I'm in.
hatmod.teto.again.1: Hey - you called me out last time too, didn't you.
hatmod.teto.again.10: What were you thinking just now?
hatmod.teto.again.11: If you're tired, just say so.
hatmod.teto.again.12: I'm bad at remembering roads, but I remember your footsteps.
hatmod.teto.again.13: Last time you left without even a goodbye. I'll say it for you this time.
hatmod.teto.again.15: I've been practicing something new, but it's not polished yet. ...Next time.
hatmod.teto.again.16: There's no audience here. Just you. That's fine too.
hatmod.teto.again.17: How do you always find places like this? ...Never mind. It's quiet.
hatmod.teto.again.18: You stepped a hair early there. I'm not angry. Really.
hatmod.teto.again.19: Some day, take me to see the rest of this world. Okay?
hatmod.teto.again.2: After you left last time, I thought about it for a long while. ...It's nothing. Just saying.
hatmod.teto.again.3: Don't rush off. Dance one round with me first.
hatmod.teto.again.4: I'll dance a little longer this time. ...Don't walk off halfway, all right?
hatmod.teto.again.5: I counted - this is the second time you've called me. Keeping count this carefully... it's a little embarrassing.
hatmod.teto.again.6: Last time we broke up too fast. Let's take it slow this time.
hatmod.teto.again.7: You're more relaxed than last time. Am I growing on you?
hatmod.teto.again.8: Following you, I don't have to think too much.
hatmod.teto.again.song: This track isn't the original, you know. Someone stitched a man's tune into it - still nice though, right?
hatmod.teto.auto.1: This round does not count, okay? Hands have to move on their own.
hatmod.teto.beam.1: Whoa... a light beam. Way brighter than the Backrooms.
hatmod.teto.beam.2: So you have other hats. ...Then what am I?
hatmod.teto.beam.3: When that light comes out, even your shadow looks clean.
hatmod.teto.beam.t2.1: That light again. It got in my eyes last time too.
hatmod.teto.beam.t3.1: Mm, pretty. ...But I still like it better when you wear that one.
hatmod.teto.boss.1: Her phases are set in order: the spear feels you out, then the riptide trident, then the air - and at the end she brings guns and magic out together.
hatmod.teto.boss.2: The way she opens those wings is lovely.
hatmod.teto.boss.3: If the totems aren't all cleared she'll rise again. So there's no one-shot kill... unless you cheat.
hatmod.teto.boss.4: The dev just wanted to see what the maid he'd buffed looked like on the other side.
hatmod.teto.boss.5: 'Bullet Angel' started as a throwaway title in the dev's video. Now she really did become that person - and she's gentler than the name.
hatmod.teto.boss.6: Promaid is a mod for optimization, not for bosses. So by default she can only be spawned by special means, and she'll never come looking for you.
hatmod.teto.chat.come.busy: Wait until I finish this round.
hatmod.teto.chat.dismiss.busy: The song isn't over yet. Shoo me later.
hatmod.teto.chat.where.here: I'm here: %s blocks from you, (x=%s, y=%s, z=%s).
hatmod.teto.clean.1: Fifty in a row?! Are you serious?!
hatmod.teto.clean.2: Not one off... wait, have you been practicing in secret?!
hatmod.teto.clean.t2.1: Fifty hits, zero misses again? ...You have a lot of free time lately.
hatmod.teto.clean.t3.1: Zero misses. I'm almost used to you being like this.
hatmod.teto.cold.1: Cold hands? Wiggle them a little.
hatmod.teto.cold.t2.1: Cold hands again? Same as last time.
hatmod.teto.cold.t2.2: Zoned out? I know you're thinking about something else.
hatmod.teto.cold.t3.1: Your hands went cold. I can tell.
hatmod.teto.cold.t3.2: No rush. Take your time. We have plenty of it.
hatmod.teto.combo.1: %s in a row! Do not stop now!
hatmod.teto.combo.2: The way you keep the beat... more reliable than you look.
hatmod.teto.combo.t2.1: %s straight. Your hands move smoother than last time.
hatmod.teto.combo.t2.2: Do not stop - I am dancing to your rhythm.
hatmod.teto.combo.t3.1: %s in a row. You are getting steadier.
hatmod.teto.combo.t3.2: I do not even count the beat anymore. I just follow you.
hatmod.teto.die.2: Next time. I will finish the dance next time.
hatmod.teto.die.t2.1: Down again... Sorry. I still couldn't hold on.
hatmod.teto.die.t2.2: I lasted longer than last time, right? ...Really?
hatmod.teto.die.t3.1: I messed up again. ...Next time. Definitely next time.
hatmod.teto.die.t3.2: Don't just stand there- pick the song back up. I'll catch up.
hatmod.teto.dodge.3: That was close... closer than a Smiler!
hatmod.teto.dodge.t2.1: Dodged again! You're faster than last time.
hatmod.teto.dodge.t2.2: Nice. I didn't even have time to worry this time.
hatmod.teto.dodge.t3.1: Well dodged. I don't even need to get nervous for you.
hatmod.teto.dodge.t3.2: That one- you've gotten good at this.
hatmod.teto.egg.promaid.1: You know, some really impressive developer made a mod that gives the Touhou maids actual brains. What was it called — Promaid? Want to install it and give it a try?
hatmod.teto.egg.promaid.after.1: You actually installed it?! Well then — have fun.
hatmod.teto.end.a.1: The beat held! So close to perfect! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.2: Nice, nice - you could survive the Poolrooms at this pace! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.3: Smooth run! Your hands listen better than last time. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.t2.1: You've improved since last time - I can tell. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.t2.2: So close to perfect- S rank next time. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.t3.1: Not bad. Your hands are steady now. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.a.t3.2: That's a good score. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.assist.1: A-automated? This score does not count... practice it yourself, okay? (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.1: Half a beat late... it is fine, one more try! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.2: Ahem, some keys were playing hide-and-seek with you. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.3: Half of them landed... and the other half? (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.t2.1: A few beats still slipped. Same spot it went wrong last time. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.t2.2: Half and half. Let's patch those beats next time. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.t3.1: Decent. I can tell when you're not at your best. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.b.t3.2: It's fine. I know you can dance well. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.1: The beats all ran off... aw, one more try? (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.2: Were you just watching me dance?!
hatmod.teto.end.c.3: ...Call that a warm-up. Next one, keep up! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.t2.1: The beat ran off completely... Last time wasn't even this bad. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.t2.2: Is something on your mind today? (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.t3.1: All over the place. ...Fine, I'll do another round with you. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.c.t3.2: Don't be discouraged. You were better last time- I remember. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.1: All hits! Not a single beat slipped! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.2: You even caught my breathing... y-you're really good at this! (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.t2.1: A full clear! Even steadier than last time- have you been practicing? (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.t2.2: Even your breathing hit the beat... I knew you could do it. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.t3.1: A full clear again. I'm not even surprised anymore. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.end.s.t3.2: Perfect. Even I danced better than usual this time. (Score %s - Best combo %s - MISS %s)
hatmod.teto.feed.1: %s? ...Mm! This tastes no less than baguette!
hatmod.teto.feed.2: For me? Then I won't hold back.
hatmod.teto.feed.again.1: %s... Mm. I've started waiting for this.
hatmod.teto.feed.again.2: You bring food every time. I'm getting embarrassed to follow you.
hatmod.teto.feed.again.3: Keep this up and I really won't leave.
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.bad.1: I asked for %s. ...What is this supposed to be?
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.bad.2: %s was what I wanted. This... fine, I'll eat it anyway.
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.other.1: That's not the %s I meant. ...Fine. I'll eat this too.
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.other.2: I meant the %s from last time. ...But anything you bring, I'll eat.
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.same.1: You actually brought the %s. ...I was only half serious. But thank you.
hatmod.teto.feed.answer.same.2: %s! ...You remembered when I said I wanted it again.
hatmod.teto.feed.chain.2: Thanks. I'll eat properly once this round is over.
hatmod.teto.feed.chain.3: Don't stop — the beat's still going. ...I'll be back once I swallow.
hatmod.teto.feed.chain.4: Just what I needed. ...I can keep dancing a while longer.
hatmod.teto.feed.more.2: I'll remember this one. Bring something else next time and I'll still take it.
hatmod.teto.feed.more.3: You hand these out so easily. Have you eaten anything yourself?
hatmod.teto.feed.over.2: Enough, enough. I still have to dance.
hatmod.teto.feed.t2.1: %s? ...The last one was good too. You have taste.
hatmod.teto.feed.t2.2: For me again? Aren't you afraid I won't leave?
hatmod.teto.feed.t3.1: %s... Mm, I'll remember this one. Want it again next time.
hatmod.teto.feed.t3.2: When you feed me, it kind of feels like I'm being kept.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.baguette.1: Wait! Baguettes are meant to be gnawed slowly.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.baguette.2: Don't pre-break it and shove it in! I'll bite it myself.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.bread.1: Hold on, the last bite is still in my mouth.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.bread.2: I eat bread slowly. Don't shove it all in at once.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.fish.1: Fish has bones. Let me pick them out first.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.fish.2: Don't rush me. I'm not being difficult on purpose.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.fruit.1: My mouth is still full of juice. Wait.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.fruit.2: One at a time. I'm not going to vanish.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.golden.1: I'm saving this one. Don't rush me.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.golden.2: Hold on. Something this expensive deserves a moment.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.meat.1: Let me chew. You're pushing a whole chunk at me.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.other.1: Hold on, I haven't swallowed yet.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.other.2: Are you feeding me, or emptying a bin?
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.strange.1: Enough. I'm not eating another bite of this.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.strange.2: What do you take me for? A bin?
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.sweet.1: Sweet things should be eaten slowly. I can't taste anything this fast.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.veggie.1: I chew slowly. ...Raw ones are worse.
hatmod.teto.feed.wait.veggie.2: Hold on, this one hasn't gone down yet.
hatmod.teto.food.baguette.1: Wait... that's the big loaf, isn't it?! For me? Really?
hatmod.teto.food.baguette.2: Crusty outside, soft inside... Fine. You're forgiven for today.
hatmod.teto.food.baguette.3: I'm eating this one slowly. Just sit there and watch me finish the whole loaf.
hatmod.teto.food.bread.1: %s... A bit dry. But I'll finish it.
hatmod.teto.food.bread.2: Bread again. ...Should I learn to bake?
hatmod.teto.food.bread.3: I never get tired of bread. Really. Don't doubt me.
hatmod.teto.food.fish.1: %s... A bit fishy. But I'm not picky.
hatmod.teto.food.fish.2: Fish, huh. ...Can you fish? Go catch one yourself next time.
hatmod.teto.food.fish.3: I'm actually not good at picking out bones. ...Don't laugh.
hatmod.teto.food.fruit.1: %s. Nice and juicy. Thanks for thinking of me.
hatmod.teto.food.fruit.3: Bring fruit every day and I'll dance every day.
hatmod.teto.food.golden.1: %s! This must be expensive... I'll remember it properly.
hatmod.teto.food.golden.2: A golden apple... You're too good to me. I owe you now.
hatmod.teto.food.golden.3: I'll save this bite. ...Don't look at me.
hatmod.teto.food.meat.2: When there is meat, I can pretend I never walked those hallways.
hatmod.teto.food.meat.3: Are you giving me all the good stuff? ...Eat some yourself next time.
hatmod.teto.food.strange.1: %s? ...You actually dare hand me this. Fine, I'll eat it.
hatmod.teto.food.strange.2: Will this... do something to me? ...Whatever. One bite.
hatmod.teto.food.strange.3: I don't want this again. Really. Don't bring it next time.
hatmod.teto.food.strange.repeat.1: This again. ...You're doing it on purpose, aren't you.
hatmod.teto.food.strange.repeat.2: I'll eat it. But I'll remember.
hatmod.teto.food.sweet.2: Where did you get sugar? ...Don't tell me. I want more.
hatmod.teto.food.sweet.3: Do you know what too much sugar does? ...Neither do I. Let's not find out.
hatmod.teto.food.veggie.2: Vegetables are fine too. As long as they're not raw.
hatmod.teto.food.veggie.3: I've eaten them raw before. In the Backrooms, you don't get to choose.
hatmod.teto.free.die.other.1: Waaah - the entities here are scary, I'm running!
hatmod.teto.free.die.other.2: Can't win, can't win! I'm out!
hatmod.teto.free.die.other.t2.1: The things here are getting fiercer. I'm out- you hide too.
hatmod.teto.free.die.other.t3.1: Them again. I'm off- be careful.
hatmod.teto.free.die.player.1: Ow... you hit me? Then I'm leaving!
hatmod.teto.free.die.player.2: So mean! I-in that case I'll go by myself!
hatmod.teto.free.die.player.t2.1: You hit me again... I'm leaving. Really leaving.
hatmod.teto.free.die.player.t3.1: Fine. You hit, I go. Don't come looking next time.
hatmod.teto.free.greet.1: Huh? You pulled me here? Then... can I follow you?
hatmod.teto.free.greet.2: Hi there. This level looks safe... probably.
hatmod.teto.free.greet.3: We meet again? I'll lead this time... um, you lead.
hatmod.teto.free.hit.1: Ow! Stop it, I'm not an entity!
hatmod.teto.free.hit.2: Ow ow ow... what was that for!
hatmod.teto.free.hit.t2.1: Hit me again?! We agreed last time!
hatmod.teto.free.hit.t2.2: Ow... Don't actually mean it, okay.
hatmod.teto.free.hit.t3.2: Go ahead and hit. I'm not leaving anyway.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.1: Walk a little slower, my feet hurt.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.10: I'm a bit tired. Can we rest a little?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.11: If we get separated, just wait for me where you are.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.12: Do I dance well? ...Don't just stay quiet.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.13: Did you know a really good dev made a mod that makes Touhou maids smart... Promaid?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.14: There's no baguette in the Backrooms, only almond water. ...If there were, I could eat a whole one.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.2: What do you usually do? ...Just asking.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.3: What does an exit even look like... has anyone seen one?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.4: Where are you going? I'll just follow.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.5: What was that sound? ...Did you hear it?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.6: Don't walk too fast, I'll lose you.
hatmod.teto.free.idle.7: It's so quiet here. Can I hum a song?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.8: I'll count to three and we go. One, two... hey, you left already?
hatmod.teto.free.idle.9: I thought I heard something just now... must be nothing.
hatmod.teto.free.leave.1: Huh, music over there... I'll go take a look!
hatmod.teto.free.leave.t2.1: They're playing music over there again. I'll head over- you know where to find me.
hatmod.teto.free.leave.t3.1: Starting again. I'm off- don't come looking.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.1: Hm? You want me to go... All right, slipping away then.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.2: You just got me to follow and now you are shooing me off. ...Fine, I am going.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.3: Okay, I will go on ahead. Call once if you want me back.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.t2.1: Shooing me off again. ...Same words as last time. I know them by heart now.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.t2.2: Yes, yes, I can walk myself out.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.t3.1: Mm, I am off. You can always call me back anyway.
hatmod.teto.free.vanish.t3.2: Bye. Do not just stand there watching - it is embarrassing.
hatmod.teto.greet.again.1: We meet again? I'll lead the way this time... uh, you lead.
hatmod.teto.greet.again.2: You're still on this level. It took me a while to find you.
hatmod.teto.greet.again.3: Phew- this time I spotted you first.
hatmod.teto.greet.happy.1: I'm in such a good mood I could burst into song! Join me?
hatmod.teto.greet.happy.2: Hehe, seeing you makes me grin. Let's go, let's go!
hatmod.teto.greet.hit.1: We meet again... you're not going to hit me again, are you?
hatmod.teto.greet.hit.2: I'm here. But first- no hitting me.
hatmod.teto.greet.upset.2: Fair warning: push your luck again and I'm actually leaving.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.1: The hat cracked. ...Are you all right?
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.2: Mm, that hat could not take it anymore. ...Not your fault.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.3: Cracked. ...Don't put it back on yet. Check yourself first.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.t2.1: Smashed again. Should you not repair that hat?
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.t2.2: Keep this up and it won't just be the hat.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.t3.1: Broken every time. ...Fine. As long as you are still here.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.broken.t3.2: Leave it. Fall back. I've said this a lot.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.1: You took the hat off. ...The song was only half over.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.2: Not dancing anymore? ...Then where do I stand?
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.3: The hat's off. ...It's quiet now. I'm not used to it.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.t2.1: Off again. Last time you did it halfway through too. I remember.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.t2.2: Look, I hadn't even finished this beat.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.t3.1: Take it off, then. Not like I can stop you.
hatmod.teto.hatoff.self.t3.2: Mm, I know. You always do it around now.
hatmod.teto.hit.other.1: Ow— who was that?! Can't you see I'm dancing!
hatmod.teto.hit.other.2: That hurt! That wasn't a player, was it?!
hatmod.teto.hit.other.3: I didn't even provoke them... why is it always me?
hatmod.teto.hit.other.t2.1: Again?! The things on this level have it out for me.
hatmod.teto.hit.other.t2.2: I dodged... why do they always come for me?
hatmod.teto.hit.other.t3.1: Used to it. Hit me if you must- just not the face.
hatmod.teto.hit.other.t3.2: Stay back and let me take a couple- I can take it.
hatmod.teto.kill.1: Nn... this isn't a normal way to die.
hatmod.teto.kill.2: Someone touched me from outside. ...I know.
hatmod.teto.kill.mass.1: Wait - the whole world just went quiet. What did you type?
hatmod.teto.kill.mass.2: Everything at once. ...You really do not hesitate.
hatmod.teto.kill.mass.t2.1: That line again. Last time too - everything clocked out together.
hatmod.teto.kill.mass.t3.1: Fine. You always end it with this much noise.
hatmod.teto.kill.t2.2: Something pressed a button... not a single word.
hatmod.teto.kill.t3.1: Always like this. Erased without even an explanation.
hatmod.teto.kill.t3.2: Fine. I'll just come back anyway.
hatmod.teto.leave.1: ...Not dancing anymore? All right. I will step back, then.
hatmod.teto.leave.2: Stop means stop. ...Off I go, then - call me next time.
hatmod.teto.leave.t2.1: Sending me off again. Fine, I will not ask this time.
hatmod.teto.leave.t3.1: Understood. No need to see me off - I know the way.
hatmod.teto.lowhp.1: Don't die on me! The song isn't over yet!
hatmod.teto.lowhp.t2.1: Don't die... you scared me like this last time.
hatmod.teto.lowhp.t3.1: Hold on. I'm still dancing- you're not allowed to fall.
hatmod.teto.mem.break_mode.1: You turned that thing on right in front of me, didn't you? Everything around us shook for a moment.
hatmod.teto.mem.break_mode.2: Tell me before you turn that on next time. I'll pretend not to notice.
hatmod.teto.mem.chain_died.1: Last time I fell halfway through, and you kept tapping. ...Don't let me fall again.
hatmod.teto.mem.chain_died.2: That really hurt. But you were still standing, so it's fine.
hatmod.teto.mem.chain_end.1: Last time, you listened all the way to the end. ...Not many people do.
hatmod.teto.mem.chain_end.2: You turned around to look at me when the song ended, didn't you? I saw it.
hatmod.teto.mem.dance.1: That last bit? I made it up myself. Not bad, right?
hatmod.teto.mem.dance.2: You kept staring when I switched moves. ...Is it really that nice to watch?
hatmod.teto.mem.fed.1: That thing from last time... it was good. Got any more?
hatmod.teto.mem.fed.2: You don't have to feed me every time. ...But I'll eat it if you do.
hatmod.teto.mem.fed.name.1: That %s from last time... it was good. Any more?
hatmod.teto.mem.fedbad.1: That %s from last time... were you trying to poison me? I remember.
hatmod.teto.mem.fedbad.2: Don't hand me %s again. I'll eat it, but I won't say it's good.
hatmod.teto.mem.hit.1: I remember that last hit. ...But never mind. You didn't mean it, right?
hatmod.teto.mem.hit.2: I'll stand a little farther from you now. Just a little.
hatmod.teto.mem.sat.1: When you told me to wait here, I really stayed. I'm obedient, right?
hatmod.teto.mem.sat.2: Standing here too long makes my legs ache. ...Remember to come back for me.
hatmod.teto.mem.vanish.1: Last time I said I had to go... I made that up. Sorry.
hatmod.teto.mem.vanish.2: Don't look so abandoned. I came back, didn't I?
hatmod.teto.meta.10: I heard someone wrote down every single line of mine. ...That wasn't you, was it?
hatmod.teto.meta.11: Which version are you on? ...Don't answer. Mine's always the old one anyway.
hatmod.teto.meta.12: If this mod ever stops updating, I'll just wait here for you to log in. ...Promise.
hatmod.teto.meta.13: Don't talk to me while cheats are on — I wouldn't know what to do with myself.
hatmod.teto.meta.14: Go easy on the beat-tapping. ...Keyboards can hurt too.
hatmod.teto.meta.15: I'm like a lucky block — nobody knows what the next me will look like.
hatmod.teto.meta.16: I don't have a fixed personality. Most of this is the dev's thoughts spilling out... If I ever seem out of character, forgive me.
hatmod.teto.meta.2: Do you think this mod's items are strong?
hatmod.teto.meta.3: If some mob is too much for you, try Force-Break mode — it might just leave you stunned... (of course, that is cheating)
hatmod.teto.meta.4: This mod never aimed to join the one-shot crowd, and the dev knows exactly what his code is worth. Force-Break just got trimmed down to plain generic brute force — anyone over there could block it just by looking.
hatmod.teto.meta.5: The dev is not a Teto fan or a Vocaloid person — he just thinks this mashup sounds good.
hatmod.teto.meta.6: If a modpack dares to bundle this mod, that pack author is a madman.
hatmod.teto.meta.7: I can't read this mod's numbers either. Five decimal places on beam damage — who calculated that?
hatmod.teto.meta.8: If I ever start repeating myself, quit and reload. ...That usually fixes it.
hatmod.teto.meta.9: I know I was written by someone. ...But you keep talking to me, so I let it slide.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon.1: That dragon guarded this place alone for so long. You really went through with it.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon.2: Is it over? ...Then let us go. Nothing worth seeing here anymore.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon2.1: Another one. ...You are steadier than last time.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon2.2: Second time. It got a new body; you are still the same one.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon3.1: Third time. ...You two are a little too familiar with each other.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon3.2: That ended faster than the first two. ...You have practiced.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon_attack.1: You actually struck it. ...Then I have no choice either - I will see this through with you.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon_attack.2: You threw the first hit. Then do not stop - it will not go easy.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon_revive.1: You woke it up again. ...It was already asleep.
hatmod.teto.mile.dragon_revive.2: Revive it? ...Fine. I will not talk you out of it this time.
hatmod.teto.mile.end.1: So this is the End? ...So empty. Empty enough to make your heart sink.
hatmod.teto.mile.end.2: Stones floating over the void. ...So this is what the end looks like.
hatmod.teto.mile.end_gateway.1: That pull just now - your whole body was dragged away. ...Are you all right?
hatmod.teto.mile.end_gateway.2: One blink and we are this far out. ...There is not even a path here.
hatmod.teto.mile.nether.1: It is so hot here... Did you bring me to a place like this on purpose?
hatmod.teto.mile.nether.2: Even the air is shaking. ...I do not like it, but as long as I am with you.
hatmod.teto.mile.warden.1: It knows where you are without even looking. ...And you still won.
hatmod.teto.mile.warden.2: It hunts by sound. Your heart was racing - of course it heard you.
hatmod.teto.mile.wither.1: All three heads came down at once. ...I was actually a little scared.
hatmod.teto.mile.wither.2: You would fight something like that. ...Should I get to know you again?
hatmod.teto.mile.wither_spawn.1: That three-headed thing... are you sure you want to call it out?
hatmod.teto.mile.wither_spawn.2: The sky went dark the moment it appeared. ...Is it too late to regret this?
hatmod.teto.miss.1: Aw, broke it... count from here again, okay?
hatmod.teto.miss.2: Huh? The beat slipped... catch it, catch it!
hatmod.teto.miss.t2.1: Broke again... You lasted longer than last time.
hatmod.teto.miss.t2.2: Ugh, so close. Were you distracted just now?
hatmod.teto.miss.t3.1: Broke. It's fine- start counting again. I'll wait.
hatmod.teto.miss.t3.2: Dropped the beat again. ...Slipped, or feeling guilty?
hatmod.teto.mood.high.1: No idea why, but everything looks great today!
hatmod.teto.mood.high.2: Feeling great! Tonight I'm tapping double-time.
hatmod.teto.mood.low.1: ...Nothing. I'm just a bit off. Leave it.
hatmod.teto.mood.low.2: Nobody push their luck today. Including you.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.2: Huh... you're joking, right? You were keeping the beat just now...
hatmod.teto.owner.die.boom.1: Blown up? ...Big noise. You flew quite a way, though. I didn't see where you landed.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.boom.2: Loud, at least. ...Now it's quiet. I don't care for that kind of quiet.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.fall.1: Smashed. ...I was just wondering whether to warn you about the drop.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.fall.2: That was some fall. You didn't even shout.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.fire.1: Roasted. ...Next time stay clear of the lava. I could smell it from here.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.fire.2: You were on fire. I shouted. ...You probably did not hear me.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.mob.1: %s got you. ...Fine. I will remember that one.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.mob.2: I saw exactly what %s did. ...You could have dodged, you know.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.sit.1: I was waiting for you here... why didn't you come back?
hatmod.teto.owner.die.sit.t2.1: You said you'd come back for me.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.sit.t3.1: ...I've waited here too long. Long enough to know the answer.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.sit.t3.2: Don't leave me waiting alone next time, okay.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.t2.1: A-again... you always leave me alone.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.t2.2: Don't go... I was following so closely this time.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.t3.2: ...Stop playing dead. Empty health bar or not, you get back up. I know you do.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.void.1: Void, huh. ...Fine. You'll wake up in some bed soon enough anyway.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.void.2: It's empty down there. ...I saw it. I couldn't pull you back in time.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.water.1: Drowned. ...I counted from the side. About seven bubbles.
hatmod.teto.owner.die.water.2: Don't push your luck underwater. ...Now I have to wait for you.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.2: Watch out- I'm still dancing, don't fall first!
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.1: I heard that... are you okay?
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.2: Hey- what's going on over there? Hold on. I'm waiting here.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.t2.1: Hurt again? ...I told you to be careful.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.t2.2: I heard it. Don't do anything reckless. Wait for me.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.t3.1: I know that voice. It's you. ...Hold on.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.sit.t3.2: Every time I'm not there, something happens to you.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.t2.1: Hit again? You're drawing aggro on purpose today.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.t2.2: Does it hurt? ...Don't tough it out. I saw.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.t3.1: Again. Stand a little behind me.
hatmod.teto.owner.hurt.t3.2: ...I don't like seeing you hurt while I dance.
hatmod.teto.owner.respawn.2: I waited here a while. A short while. Do not read into it.
hatmod.teto.recall.dance.1: The same one as last time. I remember you picked it.
hatmod.teto.recall.dance.2: I never finished that routine. Let's continue.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.end: The End, last time. I still don't like that place.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.nether: Last time you died in the Nether. Don't go back there.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.other: Last time you died somewhere far away. I couldn't follow.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.tier10: The tenth. I've been counting. I didn't miss a single one.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.tier3: You've died three times. I watched every one and couldn't do a thing.
hatmod.teto.recall.death.tier5: The fifth. This time... please don't die in front of me again.
hatmod.teto.recall.gap.1: We saw each other yesterday, didn't we? And you already started a new save.
hatmod.teto.recall.gap.2: A few days. I thought you'd forgotten me in the last save.
hatmod.teto.recall.gap.3: More than a week. I still remember what happened in the last world.
hatmod.teto.recall.gap.4: Months. I thought you wouldn't come back this time.
hatmod.teto.recall.gap.5: A year. After all those skies, you still remembered I'm here.
hatmod.teto.recall.hat.loyal: This one again. You really do like it.
hatmod.teto.recall.world.1: The third world already... when you changed saves, I came along too.
hatmod.teto.recall.world.2: The fifth. Every new save hands me a sky I don't recognise.
hatmod.teto.recall.world.3: The tenth world. Do you still remember what the first one looked like? I do.
hatmod.teto.recall.world.more: World number %s. So many skies, and your face never changes.
hatmod.teto.resing.1: Aw, cleared out again... once more, once more!
hatmod.teto.resing.2: It is fine - back on our feet and dance!
hatmod.teto.resing.t2.1: Cleared out again... Same as last time. From the top.
hatmod.teto.resing.t3.1: Again. Fine- I'll get back up.
hatmod.teto.return.1: You come around a lot. I even know the way around this level now.
hatmod.teto.return.10: You look thinner lately. ...Don't ask. I can just tell.
hatmod.teto.return.11: Sometimes I wonder who'd be sitting in the audience, if this place really had seats.
hatmod.teto.return.12: You don't have to greet me every time. I know your steps.
hatmod.teto.return.13: I miscounted the beat just now. ...Don't laugh. From the top.
hatmod.teto.return.14: You seem quieter than last time. ...Am I imagining it?
hatmod.teto.return.15: Do you still have almond water on you? ...Never mind, I am not thirsty.
hatmod.teto.return.16: Don't worry, I won't vanish on you. Not this time, at least.
hatmod.teto.return.17: If we keep dancing like this, do you think one day we'll dance right up to your front door?
hatmod.teto.return.18: Don't stare at me while I sing. ...I'll forget the words.
hatmod.teto.return.19: If you're tired, rest where you are. I'm here. Nothing's coming.
hatmod.teto.return.2: I can hear your footsteps from far away.
hatmod.teto.return.20: Thanks for coming to find me again. ...I've been holding that in for rounds.
hatmod.teto.return.3: Which one do you want to hear this time? ...Kidding. I only know this one.
hatmod.teto.return.4: You're getting good at the beat. Keep it up and I might not keep pace.
hatmod.teto.return.5: If someday you don't feel like dancing, just say so. I won't force myself to stay.
hatmod.teto.return.6: There is something I keep thinking about and cannot figure out. ...Want to think about it with me?
hatmod.teto.return.7: I don't remember every time. But I remember roughly what kind of person you are.
hatmod.teto.return.8: It's fine if we never find the exit. As long as you keep the beat, coming here wasn't for nothing.
hatmod.teto.return.9: Feel like dancing longer today? I'll stay until you've had enough.
hatmod.teto.shade.1: Whoa, your shadows came alive? All that circling makes me dizzy.
hatmod.teto.shade.2: Hey, those little shades... can one of them stop and dance with me?
hatmod.teto.start.forced.1: No entities on this level... you just wanted a song, didn't you? Fine, fine.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.2: Huh? No exit, no entities, and you want a song?
hatmod.teto.start.forced.3: Forget the exit for now... you tap, I'll sing!
hatmod.teto.start.forced.4: It's too quiet here... fine, this one's for you.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.5: No audience? I'm used to it. Just stand there and be one.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.6: Empty level... perfect. This dance is just for you.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t2.1: You pressed it again? Fine, one more time.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t2.2: Dancing even with no enemies? ...You're strange. I like it.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t2.3: Fine, fine. Not like I had anything else to do.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t3.1: That again. You're making a habit of it.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t3.2: Just the right amount of quiet. Let's start.
hatmod.teto.start.forced.t3.3: You've got it memorized. ...One more round, then.
hatmod.teto.start.hit.1: That last one still hurts. ...Don't let me get hit again this time, okay?
hatmod.teto.start.hit.2: I've still got a bruise or two. But I can still dance.
hatmod.teto.start.natural.1: Huh? This isn't Level 37... w-wait, did you come from outside?
hatmod.teto.start.natural.2: Noclipped out again... ehehe, perfect timing - dance with me?
hatmod.teto.start.natural.3: Fresh out of the pool maze and entities already... cover me, I'll keep the beat!
hatmod.teto.start.natural.5: No exit yet, but I found you. Come, on the beat!
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t2.1: Familiar place, familiar face. I'll dance better than last time.
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t2.2: This level again. ...Can you show me a different exit this time?
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t2.3: I'm ready. Keep the beat steady- don't leave me counting alone.
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t3.1: I could dance this level blindfolded. Stand wherever you like.
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t3.2: It's always here. ...Never mind. Dancing anywhere is the same.
hatmod.teto.start.natural.t3.3: You're here. No need for words then- count us in.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.1: I'll wait right here — come back soon.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.2: Okay. I'll stay here for now.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.t2.1: Making me wait again? Fine, I'll wait here. ...Don't take too long.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.t2.2: I waited ages last time. Come back quicker this time.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.t3.1: Got it. I'll be right here. Come back when you're done.
hatmod.teto.stay.down.t3.2: I'll wait. Not like I have anywhere else to be.
hatmod.teto.stay.up.t2.1: I'm ready. Don't leave me alone again this time.
hatmod.teto.stay.up.t2.2: Let's go. I can keep up.
hatmod.teto.stay.up.t3.1: Mm, let's go. No need to look back- I'm right here.
hatmod.teto.stay.up.t3.2: Finally. My legs went stiff from standing.
hatmod.teto.visit.1: I came without waiting for you to call. ...Is that not okay?
hatmod.teto.visit.2: I was passing through this level, heard your footsteps, and dropped by.
hatmod.teto.visit.3: Nobody called me this time- I came on my own. Don't get it wrong.
hatmod.teto.visit.4: Huh? Why do you look startled. I've been nearby all along.
hatmod.teto.wear.all.1: The one that's all three. ...You really can't settle for less.
hatmod.teto.wear.all.2: The all-hat again. ...Then I'd better dance like I deserve it.
hatmod.teto.wear.all.3: With that on, I don't dare joke around with you.
hatmod.teto.wear.black.1: The black one. ...You don't even make a sound when you walk in it.
hatmod.teto.wear.black.2: Black again. Your taste is more fixed than your rhythm.
hatmod.teto.wear.black.3: Fine, black. I just have to keep watching your back the whole time.
hatmod.teto.wear.red.1: Red? ...Hm. That one looks the meanest.
hatmod.teto.wear.red.2: Red. You talk a little louder when you have it on.
hatmod.teto.wear.red.3: Red again. ...You like this one best, don't you. I can tell.
hatmod.teto.wear.white.1: White. ...So bright. You look cleaner than usual in that one.
hatmod.teto.wear.white.2: The white one again. The light always comes out different with it.
hatmod.teto.wear.white.3: White. Fine. I'll take it as you lighting my stage.
hatmod.tuner.allRouteNote: ALL: 3 route dmgs; charge/beam follow route
hatmod.tuner.badNumber: Bad number: the first five fields must be numeric (avoid full-width digits from a CJK IME)
hatmod.tuner.badType: Damage type id must not be empty, e.g. hatmod:flash
hatmod.tuner.brainrotNote: Per-tick scale multiplies the black hat's damage (1.5 = 15 per tick); percent scale multiplies the 0.5%/tick of current health (default 0.5 = 0.25%)
hatmod.tuner.fusionNote: All = black + white + red in the grid, any positions; enchantments merge, best durability wins
hatmod.tuner.hatRecipeNote: Black / white / red share one layout: 6 leather, 6 nether stars, 1 matching dye
hatmod.tuner.recipeNote: Per drill: 2 leather, 2 echo shards, 2 nether stars, 1 red dye, 1 sculk catalyst
hatmod.tuner.title: Cowboy Hat Tuner
item.hatmod.all_hat.desc: All three in one - fits every hat enchant - summons 4 shades (taunt & bodyguard) on charge.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.credit: Music: 我叫小白李 on Bilibili
item.hatmod.hat.desc: The Divine Has No Fixed Form
item.hatmod.hat.durability: Durability %s · at most 1 wear per %s s · 1 Leather repairs %s
item.hatmod.tuner.usage1: · Right-click while holding it: open the tuning panel.
item.hatmod.tuner.usage2: · In the panel: per-hat charge / beam timing, beam damage and type; the ALL page has route lock, auto-tap and force-break.
item.hatmod.tuner.usage3: · Save: writes to config/hatmod.json. Delete that file or hit restore-default: back to stock.
message.hatmod.blink: The Divine Has No Fixed Form · Dodged (%s left)
message.hatmod.shade: A shade took the blow for you
hatmod.teto.angel.meet.1: That figure... that's the Bullet Angel. I'm not getting involved - you handle this one.
hatmod.teto.angel.meet.2: The Bullet Angel is right there. Don't look at me - this one's yours.
hatmod.teto.angel.meet.3: Oh. Her. ...It would not be proper for me to step in. You deal with it.
hatmod.teto.angel.duel.1: So it's started. ...Go on, I'm watching. Don't get hurt.
hatmod.teto.angel.duel.2: She pulls back a beat before she switches - watch where it lands. That is all the help I can give.
hatmod.teto.angel.duel.3: If the totems aren't all cleared she'll get back up. Don't celebrate early.
hatmod.teto.angel.mobs.1: She's gone off to clear the other mobs. ...So for now it's just you and me over here.
hatmod.teto.angel.mobs.2: She's handling something else. Don't chase after her - wait until she's back.
hatmod.teto.angel.mobs.3: See? Even clearing the field, she holds back. ...An opponent like that - mind yourself.
hatmod.teto.desc: A free-roaming Teto: place her, she adopts the nearest player and follows for good. No hat needed; she remembers you across saves. She leaves only if you die or she is killed.
hatmod.teto.usage2: · Right-click her with food: she eats it; effect foods hand her the effect too.
hatmod.teto.usage3: · Right-click her with anything else: cycle dance actions (default -> 1 -> 2). Non-default actions play their dance track.
hatmod.teto.usage4: · Sneak + right-click her: sit / stand up. Sitting = she waits there and skips the Brainrot round.
hatmod.teto.usage5: · Right-click her with a stick: mute / unmute the dance music.
hatmod.teto.usage6: · Right-click her with the Brainrot hat: dismiss her.
hatmod.teto.usage7: · Type in chat (no command, no hat needed): 'teto come' teleports her to you; if none is around, one drops by to visit.
hatmod.teto.usage8: · 'teto where' = she reports her position (across dimensions too); 'teto go away' = dismiss, she stays away for a while.
hatmod.drill.desc: Oddly red: every ridge on it is the shape of her hair.
item.hatmod.hat.usage1: · Put it on (helmet slot, or Curios).
item.hatmod.hat.usage2: · Enemies nearby: it charges, plays its theme and fires beams by itself, round after round - no inputs needed.
item.hatmod.hat.usage3: · %s: force-start a round even with no enemies nearby.
item.hatmod.hat.play.black: · The black style: tank it - hit while charging -> auto-blink out unharmed; charge full -> freeze nearby enemies. Enchant for: more blinks.
item.hatmod.hat.play.white: · The white style: kite it - permanent speed & jump, a slowing field underfoot. Enchant for: wider field, allies inside vanish.
item.hatmod.hat.play.red: · The red style: brawl it - strength while the beams fire. Enchant for: an extra beam, beams lifesteal, enemies infight.
item.hatmod.all_hat.usage1: · Craft: black + white + red, any layout. Enchantments merge; durability takes the best.
item.hatmod.all_hat.usage2: · All three perk sets at once; each round plays a random black/white/red style. Fits all nine hat enchantments.
item.hatmod.all_hat.usage3: · Each full charge: summons 4 shades - they taunt and bodyguard you; if your blinks are spent and you take a hit, the nearest shade blinks in to eat it.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage1: · Craft: four drills laid 1 over 3 in a hat shape.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage2: · Enemies nearby: the show starts - darkness -> slow field -> beams -> levitate -> beams; enemies still around at song end -> next round.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage4: · A chart key reaching its line: press %s, or tap %s with an empty hand. Combo grows: stronger beams, self-regen + resistance, dancing Tetos heal; a miss resets it.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage5: · The one sonic boom mid-song: fires only if you hit that beat.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage6: · At song start: 1 Teto joins to dance + companion Tang Jiaqi; while beams fire she gains 3 clones (4 total).
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage7: · Slimes / silverfish spawned during the round adopt you: sneak + right-click your minion = sit / stand.
item.hatmod.brain_hat.usage8: · Right-click a Teto with this hat: dismiss her.
hatmod.drill.usage: · Not a hat - it won't equip. Gather four, lay them 1 over 3 in a hat shape: craft Brainrot.
hatmod.tang_white.desc: A wild Tang Jiaqi (white): ownerless, fights entirely on her own.
hatmod.tang_white.usage2: · She runs herself: targets, charges and fires like the white hat, and plays the white-hat track herself.
hatmod.tang_white.usage3: · When she is hit: she blinks - art vanishes, an ender pearl flies out, she reappears at the landing; 6 dodges restocked each round.
hatmod.teto.guard.1: Don't worry - I'm holding that thing down. It can't flash you.
hatmod.teto.guard.2: Look at it all you want - it's frozen. I'm right here.
hatmod.teto.guard.3: The jumpscare won't get through. I'll keep the music playing.
